label.means: The label of the object written, for an object

previewClosed.means: true when a preview was showing and was taken out of the 3D view

refusalNotes: Refused over memoryLimitGB (4), with what to raise
hints: Always give path, or ask: false for the default name in the output folder
Update an out-of-date object with texture_apply first
texture_check { path } can check the STL of a Textured object later

texture_export.source: Texturizer for FreeCAD; the engine and the settings are BumpMesh's by Stefan Hermann (CNC Kitchen), ported to Python and credited (AGPL-3.0)

card.does: Prepares a body for texturing outside FreeCAD (the BumpMesh web app or its own tools).

body.means: A solid's name or label; the document's one body when left out

faces.means: Faces: names (Face3), a list, or (with Agent Link) queries such as {"normal": [0, 0, 1]}

mode.means: include: texture only these faces (default; a grip). exclude: all but them (keep a mating face plain)

path.means: The STL to write (relative: the output folder; default <label>-for-texture.stl)

name.means: A label for the default file name; not a path

effects: It writes the body as one STL, face by face from one mesh of the whole part
Beside it, it writes <name>-mask.json, which lists the triangles of faces
Faces are Face1..FaceN of the body as it is now
A smaller tolerance means more triangles in the STL
next is the bumpmesh_texture_file call to make with these files
bumpmesh_texture_file is a tool of the separate BumpMesh server, when it is connected
The mask is tied to this tessellation
Changes nothing in the document
Declared a long read: it runs as a job
Past about 45 s, the call answers with a job id, and job_status gives the answer
Only the faces listed (include) or all but them (exclude) get the texture
say the faces that must not change back to the person first
Then bumpmesh_texture_file { path, output, layers: [{ texture, settings, mask: { mode, trianglesFile } }], settings: { refineLength } } textures the STL with the output and refineLength given
texture_check { body, path: the output } measures the depth on each textured face
texture_check also measures any face it leaked onto, and whether the mesh is closed

triangles.means: How many triangles the STL has

maskTriangles.means: How many triangles the mask holds

mode.means: include or exclude: whether the faces are the ones to texture, or all but them

faces.means: [names] of the faces the mode applies to

refineLength.means: the refine length the part suits

hints: To texture inside FreeCAD, use texture_apply instead; this is not needed for it
Give the same tolerance to texture_check
If the body changes, prepare again

texture_prepare.source: Written for Agent Link for FreeCAD's draft tools; moved to Texturizer 14 Nov 2026

card.does: Measures a textured mesh against the body it was made from, face by face.

object.means: A Textured object (texture_apply's): its body, mask and mesh

body.means: For an STL textured outside FreeCAD: the solid it was made from

path.means: A textured STL (relative: the output folder)

mask.means: texture_prepare's -mask.json; found beside path by name when left out

flat.means: How far a point may move and still count as unmoved

reach.means: How far from the body a point is looked for
reach.default: the larger of 2 mm and 2 % of the body's diagonal

links.line: Or give only path: an STL that texture_export wrote from the object, matched to its object
For an STL textured outside FreeCAD, give body, path and mask
mask is not used with object

effects: A number, not a picture, says whether the texture is right
With object, its body, mask and angle limits come from what it stores, and its own mesh is measured
Paths: relative means the output folder
bare faces mean the texture is finer than refineLength, or the mask missed them
angleMasked faces stay plain by design; a part's flat underside is one
An object that is out of date is never ok: its body changed since it was textured
Then verdict is check, outOfDate is true, and the figures mix the body's change with the texture
It tessellates the body and measures every vertex of the mesh
A result near the 750 000-triangle default takes a while
Nothing is changed
The figures are of the texture only when outOfDate is false
Out of date: the mesh is of the body as it was, measured against the body as it is
So the figures mix the body's change with the texture
texture_apply { update: name } (update field), then check again
leaked: the texture reached faces that were to stay plain: check the mask (mode, faces) and run the texture again
bare: faces to be textured under a fifth of whose points moved
bare means a texture too fine for refineLength, or a mask that missed them
far: points farther than reach from the body
far means a texture deeper than reach (give reach), or the STL is not of this body
mesh: not closed; a slicer may refuse it or fill it wrong, repair before printing

verdict.means: ok or check; check when a texturing problem or an out-of-date object was found

texturedFaces.means: Per face meant for texture: points, moved (the share that moved, 0-1), mean, p95, out, into, in mm

leaked.means: faces, points, worst: faces meant to stay plain that moved (a mating face, a datum)

bare.means: Faces meant for texture where under a fifth of the points moved

angleMasked.means: Faces that BumpMesh's bottom / top angle limits cover whole

far.means: { points, reach } points farther from the body than reach

mesh.means: { openEdges, overSharedEdges } when the mesh is not closed

outOfDate.means: true: the body changed since the object's mesh was made

update.means: the object name to give texture_apply { update }

file.means: The file measured, or the object's mesh

triangles.means: How many triangles the measured mesh has

points.means: How many distinct points the measured mesh has

object.means: The name of the Textured object checked

refusalNotes: A mask in a credentials or settings folder is refused
A tolerance other than texture_prepare's is refused, because the triangle counts differ
hints: For leaked faces, fix the mask and texture again
Raise reach for a texture deeper than the default
With an open mesh, repair before slicing
Run texture_apply { update } first, then check again
Only an ok goes to the slicer
